description.value: Focacciaza is Vancouver's only focacceria on wheels, run by 'Focaccia Joe' — a Red Seal chef who studied sustainable food development and draws on Italian heritage to serve pizza al taglio (Roman-style focaccia) cut to order. The all-electric cart runs on zero emissions and is solar-panel assisted, using biodegradable paper-sleeve packaging throughout. Cyclists will appreciate the quick street-food format and the eco-conscious ethos of this one-of-a-kind mobile vendor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Focacciaza is a real, operating zero-emission Italian street food cart ('Vancouver's only Focacceria, on wheels') serving pizza al taglio. The OSM street_vendor=yes tag aligns with the website's mobile-cart description. The website's contact page provides a phone number (778-232-2476) not present in OSM, and the website URL matches the OSM tag exactly. No bike parking, washroom, or water-refill information was found in either source; takeout is the entire business model and is confirmed by the street-food format.
concerns: Phone number 778-232-2476 appears on the website contact page but is absent from OSM tags — added from website.

OSM address (1007 East Cordova Street) may be a home base or regular pitch rather than a permanent fixed location; the 'Where' subpage was not captured in the website fetch, so current operating locations are unconfirmed.
As a mobile street vendor, the listed address should be treated as approximate/variable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating street-food business with an active website, confirmed contact info, and catering services. A quick-stop takeout option well-suited to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Catering available for events up to 100 people. The website's 'Where' page was not fetched, so current regular locations are unknown.
